lessons.title: Home Energy Telemetry Ingestion via Home Assistant REST API
lessons.summary: Connect EMHASS daemon to Home Assistant sensors: household power load, solar inverter yield, and utility dynamic price feed.
checkpoints: Validate sensor data availability and unit normalization (Watts to kW)
Test bi-directional command posting to switch entities

lessons.title: Day-Ahead Solar Irradiance & Household Load Forecasting
lessons.summary: Generate 24-hour predictive profiles using weather APIs and machine learning (KNN / Random Forest) trained on historical household usage.
checkpoints: Achieve forecast Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) < 14%
Plot forecast vs actual consumption envelope

lessons.title: Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP) Dispatch Solver
lessons.summary: Solve optimal schedule for EV charging, heat pump heating cycles, and home battery charging to minimize electric bill.
checkpoints: Charge battery during low/negative price hours

lessons.title: Real-Time MPC Dispatch & Automations Hardening
lessons.summary: Run receding-horizon 5-minute MPC loop responding to sudden cloud cover or unexpected cooking stove loads without violating battery limits.
checkpoints: Prevent uncoordinated EV charging tripping main household circuit breaker
